annotations.title: Request a timing check (is now the right moment?)

description: Request a human judgment on whether now is the right moment to send, call, follow up, post or ask – considering culture, context and etiquette. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

options.description: Optional: the time options you are considering.

planned_action.description: What you plan to do, e.g. send a payment reminder.
